name: Potpots | 100mg Chocolate | Milk Chocolate Bites 100ct 1:1 THC:CBN
description:
Aim for more restful sleep with potpots Sleep formula. Each milk chocolate piece contains gourmet 35% Belgian cocoa blended with precisely dosed THC:CBN, all wrapped up in a colorful sugar coating. potpots are the premiere 1mg sugar shelled, chocolate edibles that allow you to control your dose to the exact milligram, while also being so very snackable, shareable, and microdosable. Relax with potpots Sleep and find your tranquility.

Each package contains 100 individual 1:1 THC:CBN pieces / 100mg THC total, 100mg CBN Total

Everybody has their potpots number – what’s yours?
